fullPrompts.local: Create a single independent research-guided hypothetical local observer illustration for Larissa, Neptune's small irregular moon. Wide landscape 1672x941. A low oblique view over invented dark neutral grey regolith, scattered angular stones, modest shallow depressions and uneven low ridges under restrained directional light. Grey is artistic, not measured visible colour; grain sizes, relief, material fractions and chemistry are wholly imagined. No existing body map, photograph, skin or named feature may be copied or recoloured: do not use Moon, Mars, Pluto, Proteus, Ceres or Bennu terrain. Do not portray a dated Voyager location or a mapped spectroscopy site. Larissa's unresolved near-infrared OH/2.72 micron spectral laboratory interpretation does not establish local mineral fractions or actual terrain. Keep the horizon low with black sky, whose transparency is an assumption rather than evidence of absent atmosphere. No Neptune, Sun, other astronomical disk, rings or stars: this is the local terrain card only, with no angular-size claim. No atmosphere haze, clouds, plume, liquid, exposed ocean, biology, craft, astronauts, footprints, landing or survivability suggestion. No measured shape registration or permanent Neptune-facing site implied. Crisp restrained scientific illustration, no dramatic canyon wall or glow. Add a clearly legible small bottom footer exactly 'IMAGINED — LARISSA LOCAL VIEW'. Do not add scientific scales or coordinate labels.
